name: MegaRobotics M40
summary: A compact 36 kg walking quadruped from the German MegaRobotics brand, built by an OEM partner, with 30 kg payload on flat ground and IP66. Meant for inspection routes over stairs, grating and pipe racks outside Ex zones.

germany.statusNote: Sold by MegaRobotics (MegaForce GmbH, Kaarst) as its own brand, built by an OEM manufacturing partner; "Sourcing on request", "Inquiry only", price on request. The page says CE conformity is in preparation.

sellers.name: MegaRobotics (MegaForce GmbH)
sellers.note: "Contact for pricing"; own brand for the DACH region: "MegaRobotics supplies, integrates and services the M40 in the DACH region, built by an OEM manufacturing partner." CE conformity is in preparation.

specs.label: Continuous payload
specs.conditions: flat ground; short-term standing load 100 kg (not a design value)

specs.label: Endurance unloaded
specs.conditions: about 20 km; the maker notes its model summary says up to 5 h; 2.5 h with 30 kg

specs.label: Speed
specs.conditions: up to, not stated under load
specs.quote: SpeedUp to 5 m/s (not stated under load)

specs.label: Size standing (L x W x H)
Standard sensors
specs.conditions: Pro package adds NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 8 GB, 2 lidars and a second camera

capabilities.sdk: High- and low-level SDK, ROS 1 / ROS 2, simulation model (e.g. Isaac Sim), OTA updates
notes: MegaRobotics own brand, built by an OEM manufacturing partner that the page does not name.
No explosion protection: for areas outside classified Ex zones.
Product images on the maker page are renderings, not photos of a delivered unit.
Mapping and autonomous navigation need the Pro package (Jetson Orin NX, two lidars).
Wheel-legged versions M40W and M40WS exist on the same site and are not separate records here.

evidence.task: Inspection and patrol of industrial sites, power utilities and utility tunnels
evidence.note: Listed under the maker's applications; payloads chosen per project.

researchEvidence.quote: The M40 walks where wheeled robots get stuck: stairs, grating, rubble and narrow service corridors.

openQuestions: The OEM manufacturer behind this rebranded robot is not named; it may be a version of a robot already in the database.
Product images on the page are AI renderings, so no photo was added; no video or field use of a delivered unit was found.
Price and delivery date; CE conformity is still in preparation.
